What is bun-bin?

Bun is an all-in-one JavaScript and TypeScript toolkit: a fast runtime (built in Rust/Zig on JavaScriptCore rather than V8) meant as a drop-in alternative to Node.js, plus a built-in package manager, bundler, and test runner in a single executable. The goal is to collapse a typical JS project's separate tools into one fast binary, cutting install and startup times compared to a traditional Node/npm/webpack/Jest stack.

Install bun-bin on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add bun-bin

Good to know

  • Linux kernel 5.6+ recommended (5.1 minimum)
